caption: The drawing depicts a lidded vessel with a handle, appearing to be metal, centered on a plain background. The vessel is ornate, with decorative banding around its midsection and upper neck. The main body is wide and circular at the base, tapering upward to a narrower neck. A curved handle attaches at the midpoint and extends upward, terminating in a slight curl. Two elongated, cylindrical rods protrude from the top, attached by a small chain to a ring around the neck. The entire drawing is rendered in grayscale pencil or graphite, with shading used to suggest curvature and texture. In the upper left corner, there is a faint, smaller sketch of the same vessel, showing a simplified line drawing version. The artist's signature, "MARALIAN," appears in the lower right corner of the page. The composition is contained within a rectangular border drawn near the edge of the page.
title: Lamp
